outputCopy.heroIntroduction: Local residents in Chaddesden can access professional healthcare support through the Pharmacy First scheme provided by Brook Pharmacy. This service allows eligible patients to consult a pharmacist for advice and management regarding a range of common health conditions.
outputCopy.localIntroduction:
Chaddesden is a neighbourhood ward located within the city of Derby. The local area contains a range of public facilities, healthcare settings, and outdoor spaces that serve the day-to-day requirements of local residents across the community.

Key open spaces and landmarks throughout the neighbourhood include Chaddesden Park, Chaddesden Wood Local Nature Reserve, and the Derby War Memorial. Civic and educational support is delivered through community facilities such as Derwent Community Library, The Phillip Whitehead Memorial Library Chaddesden Park, and the Derwent Family Hub. Residents access general medical care locally via NHS practices including The Park Medical Practice and Park Medical Practice Chaddesden, as well as secondary healthcare provision at Florence Nightingale Community Hospital.

To assist local residents with everyday healthcare needs alongside these established facilities, Brook Pharmacy provides Pharmacy First consultations for eligible people from the area. The Pharmacy First service covers certain common health conditions. During a clinical consultation, the pharmacist evaluates symptoms, relevant medicines, and medical history. The outcome depends entirely on this individual clinical assessment and may include tailored advice, suitable treatment, or referral to another healthcare professional.
